bullets: Swipe across the surface and hair collects in the built-in dustbin.
Press the top button to empty the dustbin without touching the hair.
Swivel left and right to clear hair from the brush head.
Use on sofas, clothing, and bedding, including cotton, linen, and wool.

copy.description: Pet hair on the couch, your clothes, and the bed can build up fast. If you are a pet parent, you know the struggle. This reusable roller lifts hair with a simple swipe. Swipe across the surface and the hair collects in the dustbin. When the bin is full, press the top button to empty it without touching the hair. The brush head swivels left and right to clear hair from itself, so cleanup is quick. It uses static to lift hair, and it is easy to store. It works on cotton, linen, and wool, on sofas, clothing, bedding, and comforters. At about 4.3 x 4.3 x 18.3 cm, it fits in a bag or in the car, and the dimensions are approximate. Keep one handy for quick clean-ups around the house.
